title: UP Mukhyamantri Fellowship Programme Online Form 2022 Last Date : 24/08/2022
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UP Mukhyamantri Fellowship portal (as notified in 2022)
2. Register with email and mobile
3. Fill academic and statement of purpose details
4. Upload documents and photo
5. Submit before 24 August 2022 (cycle closed)
shortDescription: UP Mukhyamantri Fellowship Programme Online Form 2022 – last date was 24 Aug 2022. Check UP portal for new cycles.
content:
The UP Mukhyamantri Fellowship Programme offers young professionals an opportunity to work with state government departments on policy and implementation projects.

For the 2022 cycle, online applications closed on 24 August 2022. Watch official UP government pages for future batches.
